capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: no page gives usable for the North American 48.6 kWh pack (Hyundai US "battery system capacity"; evspecs NA 269 V), treated as gross. Ratio from the same-generation European pack (different voltage, so only the ratio is used): 48.4/51.0 = 0.949 (EVDB); 48.6 x 0.949 = 46.1.

chemistry.notes: NCM (NMC) for the 2024 North American Kona Electric SE 48.6 kWh (evspecs).

nominal_voltage_class.notes: The 48.6 kWh pack is 269 V nominal (evspecs NA) with 400 V charging architecture (Weekly Driver); class 400v.

preconditioning.notes: Hyundai 2025 US SX2EV manual page: automatic when a DC charging station is set as destination or waypoint, plus manual "Activate" from the infotainment menu. Page does not name the model (SX2EV = Kona Electric), so low confidence.

dc_max_kw.notes: North American 2024 Kona Electric SE 48.6 kWh: DC max 100 kW (evspecs NA; Weekly Driver also 100 kW). The European 48 kWh pack is listed at 75 kW (EVDB; Wikipedia/ADAC 74): conflict, the North American source is used. Low confidence.

ac_max_kw.notes: North American 2024 Kona Electric SE: 10.8 kW onboard charger (evspecs); autoevolution says 11 kW for the US car.
